info.title: Ryujin Community Management API
info.description: Backend API and Groq AI Layer for Ryujin Discord Bot & Next.js Dashboard

post.description:
Record a daily check-in for the authenticated user (or specified user for admin).
Idempotent: repeating the check-in on the same day returns the existing record without double-counting.

post.description:
Public recruitment application endpoint.
Anyone can apply without a Discord Bearer token.
All sensitive PII (email, full name) is stripped / masked from the response.

get.description: Officer-only endpoint to view recruitment applications.

post.description:
Officer review of application.
On approval, automatically provisions a community member record.

get.description:
Get audit logs with role-based PII masking:
- Admins see full unmasked PII.
- Officers/Moderators see masked PII.

Evaluate real-time anti-abuse anomalies (mass joins, repeated sanctions).
Flags suspicious behavior for human review and NEVER auto-bans.

Get aggregated dashboard metrics for Next.js frontend:
- Member counts
- Active check-in streaks & averages
- Upcoming events
- Open recruitment and leave requests
- Moderation sanctions
- Tournament summaries
Paginated, searchable community members list for dashboard tables.
